name: What types of renovations increase rental property value the most?

mainEntity.name: What types of renovations increase rental property value the most?

acceptedAnswer.text: Renovations that offer a high return on investment for rental properties often focus on durability, low maintenance, and broad appeal. Kitchen and bathroom updates are frequently cited as top value-add projects, especially with modern, energy-efficient fixtures. Flooring upgrades, fresh paint, and improved curb appeal through landscaping or exterior repairs also significantly enhance a property's attractiveness to prospective tenants and can justify higher rental rates. Prioritize improvements that reduce future maintenance costs and align with local market expectations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen and bathroom updates, flooring, fresh paint, and curb appeal enhancements typically offer the highest return on investment for rental properties.
